search_window.basis: Recall of source-established U.S. food-access disruption developments since the prior hourly check; excludes undated/stale and previously identified incidents.

coverage_notes.role: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; primary production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
categories: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting sole, last, only or full-service grocery store
Storm/flood/fire/outage/facility-damage cancellation or suspension of emergency food distributions
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or material access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.assessment: No newly verified qualifying U.S. signal within the bounded window. Targeted searches primarily surfaced older incidents and historical SNAP/WIC shutdown stories; no publication timestamp or fresh direct notice established a new in-window food-access disruption.
coverage_notes.excluded: Donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, promotion, generic inflation, pre-window incidents, foreign/nonhuman food pantry incidents, and prior discoveries including Bronx Open Hand pantry and Dubach Louisiana pantry closure.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search-index freshness and source publication timestamps limit sensitivity; does not replace the primary production collector. All 12 targeted searches returned without reported search-tool failures.
coverage_notes.actions: No approval, publication, schedule, task-status or production collection modification.
